5.10.validation: 2026.11.6.24 adds the gyroscope hook to the stable tree. The new source/kernel/sensor_hook.c swaps a target process's AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET proto_ops for a private copy published with cmpxchg and rewrites ASensorEvent payloads by type: OBSERVE, ADD (integer kf32 IEEE-754), OVERRIDE with a NaN axis turned into bounded noise, and DROP on the receive path. Only established endpoints are admitted, so an accepted child never inherits the copied table. Commands 150-155 use the existing dock gate (SET_TARGET, SET_RULE, STOP, QUERY, CONFIG, PROBE); PROBE answers before init and reports the failure reason. Every entry owns one file and one module reference, callbacks are counted, and a per-entry session generation keeps an old packet from using a new session's rules. PREPARE_UNLOAD now returns EBUSY while any entry is installed or draining, and symbols are resolved through the driver resolver instead of an extra kprobe. Verified on 5.10.168, 6.1.118 and 6.12.69; 5.15, 6.6 and 6.18 are build and static-import audited. All six packages come from the same source/kernel tree.
